_about.purpose: Machine-type labels for the main vehicle in each supplied frame. Used both to seed the reference gallery and to score it.
_about.method: Each frame's largest confident vehicle box was cropped and inspected by hand. Labels describe what is visible in that crop, not what the whole frame contains.

vocabulary.tractor: Wheeled agricultural tractor: Kirovets K-700/K-701, MTZ/Belarus and similar.
vocabulary.truck: Heavy cab-over lorry, three or more axles: KAMAZ, MAZ, MAN.
vocabulary.truck_light: Light bonneted lorry: GAZ, ZIL and similar.
vocabulary.trailer: Towed body photographed without its tractor unit in the crop.

_about.caveat: Front and rear views of the same class look nothing alike to an image encoder. The seed gallery covers both views only thinly; a depot archive is what fills that in.
_about.excluded: Frame 9 is deliberately unlabelled: the crop shows a rusty tipper body from behind and could be a truck or a trailer. Guessing it would poison both classes.

1.note: KAMAZ dump, white cab, orange body

_groups_note: Frames believed to show the same physical machine. 8 and 20 share plate 597 A?? 10. The other two pairs are a visual judgement. Leave-one-frame-out scoring still leaks across these pairs, so the stricter leave-one-machine-out figure is the one to trust.
